name: MN Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司业务板块没有出现扩张、新增、缩减或出售的公告；主要业务动态集中在子公司 MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. 的两份谅解备忘录：与 Founder Energy Sdn. Bhd. 的 MOU 延长两年至 2028 年 9 月 10 日，与 China State Construction Engineering (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的 MOU 于 2026 年 8 月 6 日期满失效。
overview_en: No announcements this year involved expansion, new business, reduction or disposal of business segments; the main business developments were two MOUs of subsidiary MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd.: the MOU with Founder Energy Sdn. Bhd. was extended by two years to 10 September 2028, while the MOU with China State Construction Engineering (M) Sdn. Bhd. expired on 6 August 2026.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面的业务相关公告为子公司 MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. 的两份谅解备忘录状态更新，一份延长、一份期满失效。
segments.note_en: Group-level business announcements this year were status updates on two MOUs of subsidiary MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd., one extended and one expired.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. 与 Founder Energy Sdn. Bhd. 相互同意将谅解备忘录期限延长两年，自 2026 年 9 月 11 日起至 2028 年 9 月 10 日。
actions.text_en: MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. and Founder Energy Sdn. Bhd. mutually agreed to extend the term of the MOU by two years, from 11 September 2026 to 10 September 2028.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司公告 MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. 与 Founder Energy Sdn. Bhd. 的谅解备忘录没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: The Company announced there was no material development pertaining to the MOU between MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. and Founder Energy Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. 与 China State Construction Engineering (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的谅解备忘录于 2026 年 8 月 6 日期满失效，期内没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: The MOU between MN Power Transmission Sdn. Bhd. and China State Construction Engineering (M) Sdn. Bhd. expired on 6 August 2026 with no material developments during its term.
